name: Lakera
tagline: Real-time guardrails against prompt injection and jailbreaks for AI apps.
description: Lakera Guard sits between users and LLMs as a low-latency security layer, detecting and blocking direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, and system-prompt extraction across 100+ languages. Its models are trained on adversarial data from Gandalf, Lakera's prompt-injection game. Acquired by Cisco in 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Guards any LLM-backed app via an API in front of the model.
